fixture experiment
Data: what the intake did before any statistic
  users   control 15 (50.0%)   treatment 15 (50.0%)
  repairs and drops   none; the file passed every rule as delivered

Limitations (*): read every result below with these in view
  * fewer than 10 successes or failures on converted: control (4 of 15), treatment (6 of 15); the
      z-test's normal approximation is unreliable here
  * the top 1% of users carry 65% of spend, and 67% of users have none
  * the smallest detectable effect on converted is above a modest 5% lift for treatment vs control
      (184.3% of control); a 'not detected' result there would rule out little
  * no metric declares a pre-experiment column (pre_column in the config); CUPED is skipped

Group split: does assignment match the plan?
  treatment vs control   15 vs 15   chi-square 0.00   p 1.000
  result   consistent with the plan

Sensitivity: smallest lift this sample could detect, 80% power
  treatment vs control   15 vs 15 users   control 26.7%   detectable 49.15 pp (184.3% of control)

Primary metric, converted: effect, 95% interval, p; interval first
  treatment vs control   +13.33 pp   -20.12 to +43.65 pp   p 0.439   not detected

Other metrics: corrected for 2 comparisons (Holm, and BH = Benjamini-Hochberg)
  spend   treatment vs control   +38.333   p 0.265   Holm 0.530   BH 0.439
  converted_again   treatment vs control   +13.33 pp   p 0.439   Holm 0.530   BH 0.439
  result   unadjusted 0 of 2 below 0.05; after Holm 0 survive

Monitoring replay: 5 looks; 5% budget spread across them; a crossing = a stop allowed at that look
  treatment vs control on converted, O'Brien-Fleming spending at the sizes reached
  spending design   never crosses in 5 looks; no early stop in either direction
  naive 1.96 rule   never fires
  final look   effect +13.33 pp   adjusted 95% -23.06 to +49.73 pp   boundary |z| 2.06
